title: Held-out evaluation
disclaimer: Live Linux cases first, then constructed fixtures. Rules frozen on the constructed calibration split. Ground truth is not an input to diagnose().

cases.title: Live Linux: healthy
cases.disclaimer: Live Ubuntu netns+veth+netem+cgroup. Packets traverse a veth. Software packet loss is not optical BER/FEC. Injector label is not an input to diagnose().
cases.reproduce: python -m pilot run-linux --out public/pilot/linux && python -m pilot eval-linux --dir public/pilot/linux

diagnosis.label: healthy
diagnosis.notes: Application latency stays below the frozen threshold relative to the run head.
